    Part

    A vector file for Illustrator or Rhino. "Fabric to scale" is the production size: a 250 × 250 cm page with the artwork at 164.69%, placed exactly as in Dina Barqawi's "Finalised Fabric to Scale" file so the two line up (line widths stay as drawn). "Master artboard" is the 120 × 120 in artboard of Fabric_Masterfile_v12.pdf at 100%. With Embroidered + Print, the thread and triangle ticks go to EMBROIDERED (with the hole edges when they match the thread), the holes and the canopy edge stay in CUT so they're cut, not printed, and everything else visible goes to PRINT. Rows at 0% are left out. Current colors and label layout, true line widths. Hidden rows, the linen, the weave and the sun view are left out.
